name: 01945 · Marblehead, MA
findings: ZIP 01945 (Marblehead) has 143 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01945 (Marblehead) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
